prompt:
Image 1 is the floor plan of this room seen from above: its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall. Generate one photorealistic cinematic still of this room, the front view (the establishing view): the camera stands at the centre of the front wall, at eye level, facing the back wall, with a 35mm lens and natural textures. The room layout and furniture placement should exactly match Image 1. The place is completely empty of people: no person, figure, silhouette, mannequin or reflection of a person anywhere, including behind glass, through doorways and in the distance. Location: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE. A sleek, modern, contemporary corner office of a high-end architecture and design firm on a high floor, in warm walnut, black leather and white marble. Back wall: floor-to-ceiling glass windows over a daytime city skyline, the main light source, throwing soft daylight from behind towards the camera. A big walnut executive desk stands centred in front of these windows, facing the camera, with a high-backed black leather chair with padded arms behind it. The desktop holds rolled and spread architectural plans, a fan of wood samples, a small brushed-metal abstract figurine and a pour-over coffee station. Left wall: tall walnut shelving with architectural models and material samples, and at its centre a framed black-and-white typographic sign reading "JUST DO IT." In front of the left wall stands the seating area: a tan leather sofa against the shelving, two tan leather armchairs facing each other, and a low white marble coffee table between them. Right wall: a tall walnut door near the front corner, the way in, and a slim console with a plant next to it. Front wall, behind the camera: a pin-up wall of drawings. The open floor between the desk and the right-wall door is a clear space of pale oak flooring. Additional light comes from warm recessed ceiling spots and a black task lamp on the desk. Show only this place as described: the doors, windows and openings it names lead nowhere new, with no other exit, courtyard, corridor or outdoor view added. Light it with the sources the description names, from their direction, at a neutral daylight white balance so that whites are white; only lamps the description names may glow warm.

Avoid: people or silhouettes, readable text, labels, signs with letters or numbers, logos, watermark.
